$ tsc -p tsconfig.json
src/index.ts(11,3): error TS2322: Type 'string' is not assignable to type 'number'.
exit 2

tsc emits dist/index.d.ts regardless — noEmitOnError is off by default — and
api-extractor then reads that declaration and exits 0 with a full report. The
build's own exit code is the only thing that says the tree did not typecheck.
